notes: Troubleshooting v358 replaces the long browser-managed defer chain with one authoritative responsive bootstrap loader. The bootstrap paints the exact module name before each troubleshooting script executes, yields between modules so slower PCs remain responsive, stops on load/runtime failures with the offending filename visible, and keeps the safe Repair local cache action without clearing saved ServoForge workspace data. The v356 compact-context guard still runs immediately before troubleshooting-app.js, all source-backed fault logic is unchanged, and the offline service-worker cache generation now carries the v358 bootstrap.
